false_positive_risks: A provenance-correct and handoff-consistent artifact can still contain a semantically wrong decision-relevant extracted fact
Architecture or API effects could be laundered into mechanistic novelty if claim-type boundaries are ignored
An Assembly turnover comparator chosen before binding lifetime-memory versus working-set intent could answer a different architectural question
A biologically richer comparator could overmatch a narrow engineering/API claim and remove the phenomenon being characterized
false_negative_risks: Brittle literal or representation-sensitive extractors can block valid measurement or misclassify a decision-relevant machine fact
Fail-closed handling becomes overconservative if one disputed fact automatically rejects the candidate rather than blocking only dependent continuation
Mandating AST for facts better represented by runtime invariants or explicit documentation checks could add ceremony without information gain
Universal replication or novelty-threshold inflation would suppress useful Architecture/testbed questions without addressing extractor fidelity
Fitting a universal support threshold to completed Top-k outcomes would create post-outcome goalpost movement

machine-fact extractor validation checks whether artifact fields represent bound source/runtime semantics
artifact-to-handoff binding checks transfer into durable control-plane state
fresh Analyst review governs interpretation and successor allocation

moving_goalpost_assessment.basis: Suppression was audited without repair or relabel; Refractory's representation fix occurred before outcome and preserved the scientific contract; delayed-outcome fixed its source surface, extraction method, terminal mapping and STOP rule before raw facts and interpretation.

required_path: matched equal-privilege comparator where required by claim type
survive ordinary implementation and dynamical reductions
pass_reachability_assessment.current_limit: No active PRE_FORMAL or FORMAL object. Machine-fact extractor fidelity remains a confirmed procedural weakness, although the delayed-outcome object prospectively uses a stronger structural policy and stops before any dynamic escalation.

external_calibration.use_rule: External literature and audit calibrate ordinary reductions, comparator scope and claim boundaries; they do not override machine artifacts or rewrite consumed evidence.

opportunity_cost_assessment: Highest expected information gain now comes from observing one real fresh successor decision under the stronger extraction method plus adopted handoff binding, and from clarifying Assembly lifecycle intent before any turnover comparator. Additional global scientific strictness would target the wrong failure mode and reduce lower-funnel information gain.
prospective_recommendations: Keep the four-layer funnel, strict FORMAL novelty bar, comparator discipline, ordinary-reduction-first interpretation and hard integrity floor unchanged.
Keep decision-relevant machine-fact extractor fidelity at TIGHTEN until at least one real successor decision completes under stronger extraction plus adopted handoff binding.

Prospectively bind a fact-type-appropriate validity method for decision-relevant machine facts; prefer structural AST, typed or runtime invariants over brittle raw-string matching when they express the intended fact faithfully.
Treat the completed suppression diagnostic as calibration evidence only; never repair, rerun, rescore or relabel the historical terminal.
Honor the delayed-outcome static STOP; do not create a dynamic interleaving experiment unless fresh prospective authority first establishes a supported delayed/interleaved claim worth testing.
For Assembly mature-capacity, bind intended memory lifecycle and plausible supported saturation before selecting a turnover comparator or downstream learnability threshold.
Fail closed only for successor decisions that depend on a disputed machine fact; do not automatically reject a candidate or inflate programme-wide thresholds.
Preserve Architecture, system, engineering and testbed value even when computational-principle novelty fails.
Do not retroactively rescore, relabel, rerun, invalidate or upgrade consumed/frozen experiments because methodology safeguards improve.
